mapper.sql: select job_code, job_name, level, domain_name, weight, source_file, source_page, issue_number from job_competency_weight
mapper.select: where job_code = #{jobCode} order by field(level, '五级', '四级', '三级', '二级', '一级'), id
where job_name = #{jobName} or job_name like concat('%', #{jobName}, '%') order by field(level, '五级', '四级', '三级', '二级', '一级'), id

select id, job_code, job_name, level, domain_name, weight, source, source_file, source_page, issue_number from job_competency_weight
and job_code = #{jobCode} and job_name like concat('%', #{jobName}, '%') and level = #{level} and domain_name like concat('%', #{domainName}, '%')
order by job_code, field(level, '五级', '四级', '三级', '二级', '一级'), id
select id, job_code, job_name, level, domain_name, weight, source, source_file, source_page, issue_number from job_competency_weight where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into job_competency_weight (job_code, job_name, level, domain_name, weight, source, source_file, source_page, issue_number, create_time) values (#{jobCode}, #{jobName}, #{level}, #{domainName}, #{weight}, #{source}, #{sourceFile}, #{sourcePage}, #{issueNumber}, sysdate())
